label: Angels and life (Giada, Font of Hope): lieutenant; the monarch; "can't attack you unless" taxes; investigate and Clues with exalted; "7 life more than your starting life total"; a cast restriction by turn of the game (Serra Avenger); an alternative cost of tapping creatures (Sephara)

cards.name: Always Watching
gaps: Nontoken creatures you control get +1/+1 and have vigilance.

cards.name: Angel of Vitality
gaps: This creature gets +2/+2 as long as you have 25 or more life.

cards.name: Angelic Destiny
gaps: Enchanted creature gets +4/+4, has flying and first strike, and is an Angel in addition to its other types.
When enchanted creature dies, return this card to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Angelic Field Marshal
gaps: Lieutenant — As long as you control your commander, this creature gets +2/+2 and creatures you control have vigilance.

cards.name: Angelic Sleuth
gaps: Whenever another permanent you control leaves the battlefield, if it had counters on it, investigate. (Create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")

cards.name: Archangel of Tithes
gaps: As long as this creature is untapped, creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control unless their controller pays {1} for each of those creatures.
As long as this creature is attacking, creatures can't block unless their controller pays {1} for each of those creatures.

cards.name: Bishop of Wings
gaps: Whenever an Angel you control enters, you gain 4 life.
Whenever an Angel you control dies, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.

cards.name: Cleansing Nova
gaps: Choose one —
• Destroy all creatures.
• Destroy all artifacts and enchantments.

cards.name: Court of Grace
gaps: When this enchantment enters, you become the monarch.
At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
If you're the monarch, create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying instead.

cards.name: Defy Death
gaps: If it's an Angel, put two +1/+1 counters on it.

cards.name: Emeria Shepherd
gaps: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may return target nonland permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
If that land is a Plains, you may return that nonland permanent card to the battlefield instead.

cards.name: Endless Atlas
gaps: {2}, {T}: Draw a card.
Activate only if you control three or more lands with the same name.

cards.name: Exorcise
gaps: Exile target artifact, enchantment, or creature with power 4 or greater.

cards.name: Grasp of Fate
gaps: When this enchantment enters, for each opponent, exile up to one target nonland permanent that player controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield. (Those permanents return under their owners' control.)

cards.name: Herald of War
gaps: Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Angel spells and Human spells you cast cost {1} less to cast for each +1/+1 counter on this creature.

cards.name: Linvala, the Preserver
gaps: When Linvala enters, if an opponent has more life than you, you gain 5 life.
When Linvala enters, if an opponent controls more creatures than you, create a 3/3 white Angel creature token with flying.

cards.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
gaps: Other Angels you control get +1/+1 and have lifelink.

cards.name: Merchant of Truth
gaps: Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, investigate.
Clues you control have exalted. (Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each instance of exalted among permanents you control.)

cards.name: Metropolis Reformer
gaps: Whenever this creature is dealt damage, you gain that much life.

cards.name: Norn's Choirmaster
gaps: Whenever a commander you control enters or attacks, proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

cards.name: Reya Dawnbringer
gaps: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: Righteous Valkyrie
gaps: Whenever another Angel or Cleric you control enters, you gain life equal to that creature's toughness.
As long as you have at least 7 life more than your starting life total, creatures you control get +2/+2.

cards.name: Search the Premises
gaps: Whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, investigate. (Create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")

cards.name: Sephara, Sky's Blade
gaps: You may pay {W} and tap four untapped creatures you control with flying rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Other creatures you control with flying have indestructible. (Damage and effects that say "destroy" don't destroy them.)

cards.name: Seraph of the Sword
gaps: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to this creature.

cards.name: Seraph Sanctuary
gaps: Whenever an Angel you control enters, you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Serra Avenger
gaps: You can't cast Serra Avenger during your first, second, or third turns of the game.

cards.name: Speaker of the Heavens
gaps: {T}: Create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying.
Activate only if you have at least 7 life more than your starting life total and only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Starnheim Aspirant
gaps: Angel spells you cast cost {2} less to cast.

cards.name: Sunblast Angel
gaps: When this creature enters, destroy all tapped creatures.

cards.name: Thraben Watcher
gaps: Other nontoken creatures you control get +1/+1 and have vigilance.

cards.name: Vanguard Seraph
gaps: Whenever you gain life for the first time each turn, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)

cards.name: Wojek Investigator
gaps: At the beginning of your upkeep, investigate once for each opponent who has more cards in hand than you. (To investigate, create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")

cards.name: Youthful Valkyrie
gaps: Whenever another Angel you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

cards.name: Tyrant's Familiar
gaps: Lieutenant — As long as you control your commander, this creature gets +2/+2 and has "Whenever this creature attacks, it deals 7 damage to target creature defending player controls."
